en.HOWTO_BODY:
1. Touch & drag across 3+ orthogonal matching smiling organs.
2. NADI LOOP: Loop back onto an earlier tile in your 4+ chain to unleash an 8-Way Super Pulse (+1 Shield, +10 Pulse, 3 bonus clears, 1.5x score)!
3. ENDPOINT PULSE: Your final tile pulses neighbors BEFORE tiles drop.
   • Green Care: +1 Shield & +8 Pulse Meter.
   • Golden Bloom: +20 Care Energy & +6 Pulse.
   • Orange Overload: Unshielded deducts 10 Pulse & locks up to 2 tiles for 1 move.
4. TACTICAL CARE DOCK: Spend Care Energy anytime without losing a move!

Note: Pulse Meter is a fictional game resource, not a real medical measurement.
en.CREDITS_BODY:
NADILOOPA (Working Title — Codename Only • 100 Stages)
Built autonomously in Godot 4.7.2.

• Original Glossy 2.5D Smiling Organ Characters & Tropical Sanctuary Art
• 4 Original Bamboo Marimba / Gamelan-Inspired BGM Tracks & 21 SFX
• Typography: Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

Health Disclaimer: NADILOOPA is a casual puzzle game for entertainment. The fictional 0–100 Pulse Meter, Care Shields, and Overload hazards do not measure vital signs, diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical condition.

id.HOWTO_BODY:
1. Sentuh & seret melewati 3+ organ tersenyum yang sama secara lurus.
2. NADI LOOP: Putar kembali ke ubin awal pada rantai 4+ untuk memicu Denyut Super 8-Arah (+1 Perisai, +10 Nadi, 3 ubin bonus, skor 1.5x)!
3. DENYUT UJUNG: Ubin terakhir memengaruhi tetangga SEBELUM ubin jatuh.
   • Care Hijau: +1 Perisai & +8 Meter Nadi.
   • Bunga Emas: +20 Energi Care & +6 Nadi.
   • Overload Oranye: Tanpa perisai, -10 Nadi & kunci maks 2 ubin 1 giliran.
4. JURUS TAKTIS CARE: Gunakan Energi Care kapan saja tanpa mengurangi langkah!

Catatan: Meter Nadi adalah sumber daya fiktif game, bukan pengukuran medis.
